style_hypothesis_result.requested_test: flat graphic gouache with 4-6 broad value masses and minimal texture localized only at active clue/contact
style_hypothesis_result.observed: All 50 panels retain dense surface modeling across terrain, cloth, hair, wood, stone, water, maps, or metal. The arm is visually coherent but functions as detailed painterly clear-line art rather than the requested lower-density style.
style_hypothesis_result.production_value: Narrative staging, adult-role continuity, action clarity, and cadence remain useful evidence even though the style-density hypothesis fails.
